topic: How do distributed satellite constellations impact orbital configuration trade-offs between coverage and inter-satellite interference mitigation?
consensus_response: Distributed satellite constellations impact orbital configuration trade-offs by balancing coverage and inter-satellite interference mitigation through techniques like LDMA, CDMA, beamforming, and phased arrays. These methods enhance SINR and reduce interference but introduce complexities like adaptive signal processing and calibration, affecting system scalability and performance.
reference_context: SatCom protocols and antenna technologies mitigate interference, enhancing constellation performance.
